svg.text: Enter, Space or the button starts the reveal
the stagger shrinks so 30 seats take as long as 6
each seat keeps a chip with its value
the spread first; a click on a bar sets the final value
At most 1.6 s in total. Enter, Space or a click skips to frame 4. With reduced motion, frames 2 and 3 are skipped: faces swap and the histogram appears.
